name: Geerling llama.cpp Vulkan on rtx2080ti (pi host): gpt-oss-20b Q4_K_M pp512 381.67 tok/s
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Jeff Geerling, geerlingguy/ai-benchmarks). llama.cpp build f9ec8858e (7474), backend Vulkan, default llama-bench flags (ngl 99). Host: Raspberry Pi CM5 16GB, Pi OS Trixie, PCIe-attached card. Model file size 10.81 GiB, 20.91 B params, Q4_K_M. prefill tok/s, prompt length 512, per-request, batch 1. NOT aggregate. Whole-system wall power during the run 84.5 W (node scope, not device).
notes: Source issue prints the llama-bench mean and the +/- spread; the stored value is the mean. The Pi-host rows are the same physical GPU on a PCIe-constrained host, so they are not a card ceiling.
